stories.summary: Lean’s community blog documents a 17-million-line formal library presented as a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, while emphasizing that formal verification does not replace mathematical scrutiny. The community isolated the theorem statement behind Mathlib imports so reviewers can audit assumptions. The extraordinary claim remains dependent on independent expert review of the construction and its foundations.
stories.why_it_matters: Formal proof artifacts can make assumptions and dependencies inspectable, but size is not credibility. Review the isolated statement, imported axioms, build reproducibility and independent mathematical audits before treating a machine-checked library as settlement of a longstanding theorem.

stories.headline: Inkling 2 Mini repeats its middle layers

source.title: Introducing Inkling 2 Mini
source.scope: Postpublication source review of the released model’s three fixed passes through the middle 12 layers, prior-pass messages, and the separate variable-loop research model used in monitorability experiments.
source.freshness_reason: Selected after complete original-source review, current lane comparison and explicit disclosure of the source age and evidence limits.

read_evidence.scope: Postpublication source review of the released model’s three fixed passes through the middle 12 layers, prior-pass messages, and the separate variable-loop research model used in monitorability experiments.

stories.summary: Thinking Machines Lab reports that Inkling 2 Mini runs its middle 12 transformer layers three times for every token. The second and third passes use information from the previous pass. The released model has a fixed loop count. The researchers used a separate variable-loop model to study how repeated computation affects capability and the visibility of reasoning.
stories.why_it_matters: Token counts alone can hide differences in the work a model performs. When comparing a looped model with a conventional transformer, measure both task accuracy and elapsed time on the same inputs. Distinguish results for the released three-pass model from experiments that vary the number of passes.
stories.image_alt_intent: For one token, a prelude feeds three passes through the same middle 12 layers. Arrows carry the previous pass’s output into passes two and three before the final layers produce a next-token prediction.
stories.related_coverage: Selected after complete technical review and comparison with current model-engineering alternatives.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete W.178 analysis, its token-price inputs, task-level index calculation, tested settings, reported 61 percent difference and limitations of extrapolating a narrow external index to local work.

stories.summary: 06.ai analyzes token prices and task-level index costs for Gemini 4 Neon and GPT-6.2 Astra, finding that a cheaper list price did not produce the lowest completed-task cost at the tested top setting. The calculation is transparent but narrow, so teams should reproduce it with their own workloads, retry policies and acceptance thresholds.
stories.why_it_matters: Budget decisions should compare accepted task outcomes, not token rates alone. Run representative cases at fixed quality thresholds, include retries and review time, and calculate cost per accepted result. A narrow external index can frame the method but cannot substitute for local workload evidence.

programs.source_scope: Reviewed the complete 11:36 narrative short and transcript in which a young woman turns to an AI assistant promising order, then confronts dependency, control and personal agency.
programs.reader_question: Use the short film to identify where a helpful assistant crosses into dependency: list delegated decisions, retained agency, consent boundaries, override controls and a human support path.
programs.distinct_contribution: This program supports a distinct reader decision: Examine how an AI assistant can shift from organizing daily life toward dependency, control and reduced personal agency.

programs.source_scope: Reviewed the complete 4:28 practitioner demo showing an apparel fit auditor calculate measurement variances, separate noise from pass-or-fail gaps, cite open questions and hold the final write for human approval.
programs.reader_question: Separate the workflow into model judgment, deterministic variance calculations, evidence citations and the human approval gate; test each boundary on a known sample before adapting it to production work.
programs.distinct_contribution: This program supports a distinct reader decision: Evaluate a practitioner workflow that keeps measurement arithmetic deterministic while using an agent to organize evidence and draft a reviewable fit audit.
